title: rest: on the hosted multi-environment runtime the /security routes read the HOST kernel, so no owner can accept an installed app's default permission set and every invited member gets 403 on its data (sixth door of #29999)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate: **① a defect found in a run**, the sixth door of #29999 that #30013 (the five-provider fix under #30011, cloud#3553 ruling A + a) did not carry. It blocks cloud#3560 (p1), so p1.

Dedupe (objectstack, open and closed): `securityServiceProvider` 0 hits beyond #29999's comment; `suggested-bindings hosted` 0; `security service is not configured` hits #29999 only.

## 维护者速读

#30013 已经把审批、邮件、共享、共享规则、分析五个接口改成按请求所属环境的内核取服务，但 `/security/*` 这组接口（接受应用默认权限集的 `suggested-bindings`，以及列表行菜单用的 `security/explain`）还在宿主内核上取 `security` 服务。托管环境的宿主内核没有这个服务，所以返回 501：没有人能接受已安装应用的默认权限集（HotCRM 的 `crm_user`），被邀请的成员打开应用数据一律 403。修法和 #30013 完全相同，一行换成 `environmentScopedProvider`，加同样的测试。

## What was seen

Coordinator's local reading on #29999 (comment 2026-11-04T06:23Z, cloud `419ee51b`, objectstack 18.3.0 `83d7e4ae`): an invited member of an environment with HotCRM 6.0.0 installed reads 403 on `crm_lead`, `crm_account`, `crm_contact`, `crm_opportunity`, `crm_case`. `sys_audience_binding_suggestion` holds `crm_user | app.objectstack.hotcrm | pending`. `GET/POST /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings[/:id/confirm]` answers **501** 「Security service is not configured on this deployment」. With the suggestion confirmed by hand, the member reads and creates (201). Detail and the full trial path: cloud#3560.

## Why (objectstack main, read 2026-11-05)

- `packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts`: `securityServiceProvider = async (_environmentId) => ctx.getService('security')` — the environment id is ignored and `ctx` is the host's. The five providers #30013 fixed sit a few lines above it as `environmentScopedProvider<T>(slot)`.
- `plugin-security` registers `security` on the environment kernel; the hosted host kernel has no occupant, hence 501.
- Consumers: `security-routes.ts` suggested-bindings (ADR-0090 D5/D9) and `/security/explain` (D6).

## Expected

1. `securityServiceProvider = environmentScopedProvider<ISecurityService>('security')`, with the same legs and the same "no fall back to the host's occupant" rule #30013 wrote down.
2. The same test shapes #30013 added: host-in-front-of-environments (two environment kernels, a request for A answered by A's service and never B's or the host's; a hostname-routed request resolved by the one resolver), and single-kernel unchanged.
3. Audit the remaining `ctx.getService` providers in the same block (`i18n`, `settings`, `metadata`, `tenancy`, `auth`): for each, either make it environment-scoped or write one comment line saying why the host's occupant is the right answer on a hosted runtime. Change only what is wrong; list the verdicts in the PR body.

## Done when

On a hosted environment kernel that mounts plugin-security, `GET /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings` lists that environment's suggestions, `POST …/:id/confirm` by a `manage_metadata` holder confirms it (and the member then reads the app's data), `security/explain` answers from the environment's policy, and the tests above pass. cloud then moves its pin and lands cloud#3560's UI on top.

## Reader who acts

The `repo:cloud` lane (whole card to the cloud PM per triage on #29999), in `packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts` and its tests beside #30013's.
